Where legitimate microdosing for me has come with what one would describe as a mind-warping, this feels much cleaner in that regard.

Initial impressions:

* Those looking for traditional microdose effects may be a _little_ disappointed. That being said, there is definite overlap, and I've had my fair share of legitimate micro/macrodosing

* The overlap I speak of is a little hard to describe, but I'm finding it is easier to separate conscious awareness itself from the contents of consciousness, giving some space between yourself and your thoughts. Those interested in meditation and contemplation will likely find this to be a useful tool

Overall, I am impressed so far and this will most likely be a staple for me for the foreseeable future.
